title: SK Hynix set to benefit as South Korea's ruling party seeks to ease capital-raising rules
title_zh: 韩国执政党寻求放宽融资规定，SK海力士将从中受益
summary: South Korea's ruling party is seeking to make it easier for chipmaker SK Hynix to set up ventures to ‌build factories with outside investors — a move that follows a government ‌push to position the country as an AI powerhouse.
summary_zh: 韩国执政党正在寻求让芯片制造商 SK 海力士更容易与外部投资者设立合资企业，建厂——此举是在政府推动将韩国定位为人工智能强国之后采取的。

title: Nvidia halves Asia buyer list in China chip crackdown, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，英伟达在中国芯片打击行动中将亚洲买家名单减半
summary: Nvidia has more than ‌halved the number ‌of Asian customers authorised to ​buy its AI chips after creating a new "white list" of ‌companies ⁠that have passed tougher compliance checks ⁠aimed at preventing the products from ​reaching China, ​the ​Financial Times reported ‌on Mo...
summary_zh: 据《金融时报》报道，英伟达在制定了新的公司“白名单”后，已将授权购买其人工智能芯片的亚洲客户数量减少了一半以上，这些公司已经通过了更严格的合规检查，旨在阻止产品进入中国。

title: TSMC seen riding AI boom to fifth straight quarter of record profit
title_zh: 台积电有望乘着人工智能热潮，连续第五个季度实现创纪录的利润
summary: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced AI chips, will likely notch a fifth consecutive quarter of record earnings, driven ‌by booming AI infrastructure spending.
summary_zh: 在人工智能基础设施支出蓬勃发展的推动下，全球最大的先进人工智能芯片制造商台积电可能会连续第五个季度实现创纪录的盈利。

title: Why Fortune 500 companies are flocking to open source AI
title_zh: 为什么财富 500 强公司纷纷涌向开源人工智能
summary: Ollama CEO Jeffrey Morgan joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to explain how open-source AI models provide cost savings, data control, and secure localized deployment for major enterprise clients like the Fortune 500.
summary_zh: Ollama 首席执行官 Jeffrey Morgan 与雅虎财经的 Josh Lipton 一起解释开源 AI 模型如何为财富 500 强等主要企业客户提供成本节约、数据控制和安全本地化部署。

title: Wall Street ends lower as Iran tensions dampen risk appetite
title_zh: 由于伊朗紧张局势抑制风险偏好，华尔街收低

title: Meta's data center costs are skyrocketing. Here's what you need to know.
title_zh: Meta 的数据中心成本正在飙升。这是您需要了解的内容。
summary: Meta (META) raised the budget for its Louisiana data center from $27 billion to $50 billion. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley takes a closer look at the company's surging costs.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 将其路易斯安那州数据中心的预算从 270 亿美元提高到 500 亿美元。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利（Dan Howley）仔细研究了该公司飙升的成本。

title: 'Scam Altman strikes again': Why SpaceX CEO Elon Musk was beefing on X over the weekend
title_zh: “诈骗奥特曼再次出击”：为什么 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克在周末对 X 表示不满
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) and Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk was sparring with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman on X over the weekend. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 周末，SpaceX (SPCX) 和特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 与 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 在 X 上发生了争执。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详...

title: Chip stocks may be selling off, but profits are set to triple by 2027: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 芯片股可能遭到抛售，但到 2027 年利润将增加两倍：每日图表
summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is holding strong despite the recent sell-off in chip stocks. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look.
summary_zh: 尽管最近芯片股遭到抛售，但标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 仍保持坚挺。雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 进行了仔细研究。

title: Retail investors are cashing out of Apple, Tesla, and chip stocks: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 散户投资者正在从苹果、特斯拉和芯片股中套现：每日图表
summary: Retail is selling former leaders, but record market breadth shows the broader rally is still holding up.
summary_zh: 零售业正在抛售前领头羊，但创纪录的市场广度表明更广泛的涨势仍在持续。
